description: Vantaan kiintopisteet is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vantaan kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Vantaa's fixed points on the map. The material can be viewed in the City of Vantaa's map service: - The levels can be found in the map service by searching for 'Fixed Points', or by clicking here. Coverage: Vantaan kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. The portal shows the English title as "Control points in Vantaa" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vantaan kaupunkiympäristön toimiala. Its keywords include kiintopiste, benchmark, map, kartta. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
